identificationModule.briefTitle: Study of 177Lu-PSMA-617 In Metastatic Castrate-Resistant Prostate Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: VISION: An International, Prospective, Open Label, Multicenter, Randomized Phase 3 Study of 177Lu-PSMA-617 in the Treatment of Patients With Progressive PSMA-positive Metastatic Castration-resistant Prostate Cancer (mCRPC)

designInfo.interventionModelDescription: Participants in the Main Study were randomized in a 2:1 ratio to receive either 177Lu-PSMA-617 plus BSC/BSoC or BSC/BSoC only. The sub-study was conducted in a non-randomized cohort (AAA617+ BSC/BSoC)

armGroups.label: 177Lu-PSMA-617 plus best supportive/best standard of care (BS/BSOC)
armGroups.description: Patients randomized to receive the investigational product received 7.4 GBq (+/- 10%) 177Lu-PSMA-617 intravenously every 6 weeks (+/- 1 week) for a maximum of 6 cycles. Best supportive/best standard of care (BS/BSOC) might be used
interventionNames: Other: Best supportive/best standard of care

armGroups.label: Best supportive/best standard of care (BS/BSOC) alone
armGroups.description: Patients randomized to this arm received best supportive/best standard of care (BS/BSOC) as determined by the investigator
interventionNames: Other: Best supportive/best standard of care

interventions.name: 177Lu-PSMA-617
interventions.description: Administered intravenously once every 6 weeks (1 cycle) for a maximum of 6 cycles. After 4 cycles, patients were assessed for (1) evidence of response, (2) residual disease, and (3) tolerance to 177Lu-PSMA-617. If all 3 assessments were met the patient might received an additional 2 cycles of 177Lu-PSMA-617.
